name: bug-agent
description: Hourly Azure DevOps agent, one user story per cycle: Haiku pulls the story's New Bugs or Tasks assigned to you, Opus plans each against the acceptance criteria, Sonnet applies it live in your project on fix/us-<story> or feature/us-<story>, Opus reviews it, and you get a report outside the project plus a review alert. Nothing is committed: you review and commit.

azure_org.title: Azure DevOps organization
azure_org.description: The part after dev.azure.com/ in your Azure DevOps URL

azure_project.title: Azure DevOps project
azure_project.description: Project name exactly as shown in Azure DevOps (spaces are fine)

azure_pat.title: Azure DevOps personal access token
azure_pat.description: Scope: Work Items (Read). Use Read & write only if you enable comments. Stored in your OS credential store.

assigned_to.title: Assigned to
assigned_to.description: @Me for the token's owner, or a display name / email

bug_states.title: Work item states
bug_states.description: Comma-separated states of Bugs and Tasks to pick up

max_bugs_per_cycle.title: Max work items per user story
max_bugs_per_cycle.description: Each cycle works on one user story; at most this many of its Bugs (or Tasks), the rest wait for the next cycle

auto_commit.title: Commit automatically
auto_commit.description: Off (default): changes stay uncommitted in your project for you to review and commit; the next user story waits until you do. On: one commit per item, no review gate

review_alert_minutes.title: Review alert after (minutes)
review_alert_minutes.description: Desktop notification this long after a user story's work is done: ready for staging or not, and whether you've reviewed it yet

report_dir.title: Report folder
report_dir.description: Where reports (.md) and full diffs (.patch) are saved, outside your projects. Empty = the plugin's data folder/reports

work_item_types.title: Work item types
work_item_types.description: Comma-separated types to pick up when assigned to you. Bugs are fixed, Tasks are implemented

bug_branch_prefix.title: Bug branch prefix
bug_branch_prefix.description: Bugs go on a branch named prefix + user story number (e.g. fix/us-12345). An existing branch in the same family (fix/...) containing the story number is reused

task_branch_prefix.title: Task branch prefix
task_branch_prefix.description: Tasks go on a branch named prefix + user story number (e.g. feature/us-12345). An existing branch in the same family (feature/...) containing the story number is reused

base_branch.title: Base branch override
base_branch.description: Empty (default) = every new branch is cut from each repository's own root branch, detected automatically (main, master, trunk, ...). Set a name (e.g. UAT) only to cut from that branch instead; repositories without it still use their root branch

sync_branch.title: Sync new branches with (optional)
sync_branch.description: Empty (default) = no sync, since new branches already start from the root branch. Only useful with a base branch override, e.g. base UAT + sync master. On a merge conflict the new branch is removed and the item goes to a human

branch_mode.title: Branch mode
branch_mode.description: checkout (default) = switch your project folder itself to the story branch so you watch the changes live in your IDE (refused if it has uncommitted changes of your own); worktree = use a separate folder and leave your checkout alone

post_comments.title: Comment on bugs
post_comments.description: Post the root cause and fix branch as a comment on each processed bug (needs Read & write PAT)
